name: Conkeldurr

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.text: If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

flavor:
Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more
durable than normal concrete, even when the
compositions of the two materials are the same.
